note: ADR 1107: a store destructure in an effect's apply, in a function nested in a ref callback, in a function handed by name to createMemo and called by the body, with a default and with a rest element. Chrome reports STRICT_READ_UNTRACKED at each; SC1003 is a violation at each (HandedAndCalled since ADR 1166). Round 2: a sub-pattern binding no name (`{ a: {} }`, `{ items: [] }`), a sibling sub-pattern in a helper, `{ then, v }` in an apply and a quoted key all warn.
